locator: Nestlé forest supply chains page, « Cocoa deforestation-free status » and methodology definitions
summary: Nestlé reports 91.7% of its primary cocoa supply chain as assessed deforestation-free for 2025, representing 317.7 kilotonnes; the page shows 8.3% as unknown. Its methodology combines traceability to non-very-high-risk origins, on-the-ground assessment and satellite monitoring, and the page says the calculation methodology changed in the first half of 2026.
limitations: Company disclosure; the unknown share is not evidence of deforestation, and the assessed deforestation-free share is not proof that every farm in the full upstream chain was independently verified.
